I told Hollis in the #central-team thread that the signed paperwork says 40 seats for Marrow Agrisupply.

- The Affiliate Amendment (signed 2025-10-02, effective 2025-10-15) set Marrow Agrisupply at 40 seats.
- The 2026 renewal order form (signed 22 Apr 2026, effective 1 May 2026, running to 30 Apr 2027) left those seats as the amendment set them.
- The Marrow Agrisupply account page, updated 2026-09-15, also says 40.

I also flagged that Tobias posted 382 seats in that channel on Oct 14. I asked him then what that was based on, and he still hasn't answered. I found no document showing 382, so I told Hollis to use 40 unless Tobias can point to a new amendment or true-up.

My reply gave only seat counts and dates, no prices. Hollis is in #central-team and on the Central team, which owns this account.
